{{Top|leg}}
A '''multipack''' was essential equipment carried by a [[Scout/Legends|scout]], designed to carry a multitude of tools. Standard multipacks included three [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]], two [[Glowrod/Legends|glowrods]], two [[Breath mask/Legends|breath masks]], twenty-four [[breath mask filter]]s, and a [[Standard week/Legends|week's]] worth of [[Ration pack/Legends|rations]]. The multipack also included pockets and attachment points to carry a [[survey datapad]], [[cutting blaster]], [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]], [[ThinHut]], [[Portable heater/Legends|portable heater]], [[Universal Recharger]], [[HydroExtractor]], and a patching kit for [[Thinsuit/Legends|thinsuits]] and ThinHuts.
